title: Trying banjo, guitar and violin
summary: He tried banjo chords, gave up guitar for his fat fingers, and wanted brass.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: What about that guitar and the banjo at this time? Were you fooling around with them at all?

No. I tried to play banjo. I did a few chords during that time because I didn't want to leave no instruments out. But, much as I did, I just played just a few chords. I knew quite a few on that. But, when it got to be a guitar with 6 strings, then I gave it up. I said to the thing, I said I have kind of fat fingers. I didn't want to be bothered. I even tried to play violin when I was quite young, you know. But, I didn't see that one, and I wanted to get into brass.
